## Custom coded sites that outperform. PandaCodeGen is a custom web development studio for businesses that have outgrown WordPress, Shopify and other template platforms. We rebuild the digital foundation behind revenue: the website, how search engines and AI systems understand it, and, when required, the tracking used to measure performance. Our work includes controlled migrations to custom Next.js, ecommerce with real pricing and payment logic, and internal tools such as CRMs, dashboards and operations platforms. Each migration begins with a complete URL and content inventory, mapped redirects, preserved metadata, a controlled cutover and post-launch monitoring. We structure content for search and AI visibility, but we do not promise rankings, traffic or citations that no agency controls. Every engagement includes a fixed written scope, measurable acceptance criteria and full ownership of the code and production accounts. Tracking and analytics verification is scoped separately because not every project needs it. PandaCodeGen is operated by Panda Group Ventures L.L.C., based in Texas. We work with businesses across the United States and worldwide. Every plugin update was a risk. We build custom-coded alternatives instead: faster, cheaper to run, no third-party plugin dependency. Every project carries a 90+ Google PageSpeed target, verified across three recorded runs before handover, and you own the code outright. ### What Sets Us Apart Zero Plugin Dependency Body Every build is custom coded from scratch. No WordPress plugins, no Shopify apps, no page builders. Your site doesn't break when a third party pushes an update. You own 100% of the code. Title: 91+ PageSpeed on Every Project Body We don't ship slow sites. Every project we deliver scores 95 or higher on Google PageSpeed. Fast sites rank higher, convert better, and cost less to run. Performance isn't an add-on, it's the baseline. Fixed Price, No Surprises Body Every project starts with a fixed-price deposit. No hourly billing, no scope creep invoices. If you're not happy after the first sprint demo, we refund your deposit. You keep the designs. Zero risk. #### Tools and Technology Slack Zoom Google Meet RingCentral Google Drive GitHub Canva Vercel Google Docs Google Sheets Notion ### Commonly Asked Questions #### How many clients do you work with at a time? We intentionally keep our active projects small, typically 4-5 at a time. This means every client gets direct access to the founder and engineer building their project, not a junior developer or account manager. We'd rather deliver fewer projects at a higher standard than spread ourselves thin. If we're at capacity when you reach out, we'll let you know upfront and give you a realistic start date. Drop them in, save, publish. Mobile padding time. #### How do you typically collaborate with clients? We work in 2-week sprints. You get a demo at the end of each sprint so you can see real progress, not just wireframes and promises. Communication happens over whatever you prefer, email, Slack, or Google Meet. We start every project with a 15-minute discovery call to understand your goals, then deliver a clear scope with fixed pricing before any work begins. No surprises, no disappearing for weeks. #### What is your success rate or typical ROI for projects? Our most recent project replaced a WordPress site and three separate paid tools with a single custom-built system. Monthly platform costs went from $200+ to under $25. Site load time dropped from 3+ seconds to under 1 second. The business runs $48K/month in revenue on infrastructure that costs less than a Netflix subscription. Every project we take on is designed to pay for itself through reduced costs, faster performance, or increased conversions. #### How do you measure success? We measure success by three things: PageSpeed score, load time, and business impact. Every site we deliver must score 91+ on Google PageSpeed and load in under 1 second. Beyond that, we track whether the rebuild actually moved the needle for the client. Faster sites, lower hosting costs, better conversion rates. If the site looks great but doesn't perform, we haven't done our job. #### What types of projects is your team interested in taking on right now? We're focused on three areas: WordPress and Shopify migrations to custom Next.js builds, custom ecommerce platforms with complex pricing or product logic, and internal business tools like CRMs, dashboards, and operations platforms.
